privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: This site - adrianantosiak.pl - uses no tracking cookies, collects no analytics, and shows no ads. Personal data is processed only when you choose to email or call me.
sections: The data controller is Adrian Antosiak. For anything related to personal data, contact kontakt@adrianantosiak.pl.

Visiting the site on its own does not store personal data on my side. The host, GitHub Pages, may keep technical server logs (IP address, user-agent, request time) under its own policy - I have no access to them. If you email kontakt@adrianantosiak.pl or call, I retain your name, email or phone number, and the content of your inquiry.
I process correspondence under GDPR art. 6(1)(b) (steps taken at the request of the data subject prior to entering into a contract) and art. 6(1)(f) (legitimate interest in replying to inquiries).
Emails are kept in my inbox for as long as needed to handle the inquiry and any reasonable follow-up, after which they are deleted or archived.

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc., USA). Email is handled by iCloud+ Custom Email Domain (Apple Inc., USA) - messages sent to @adrianantosiak.pl are delivered to my iCloud inbox. Web fonts are self-hosted alongside the site, so fetching them sends no data to any external provider. No data is shared with any other recipients.

The site sets no cookies. Browser localStorage stores only interface preferences (chosen language and color theme) - this data never leaves your browser and is not used for tracking. I do not use Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, Hotjar, Clarity, or similar tools.

You have the right to: access your data, rectify it, erase it, restrict processing, object, data portability, and lodge a complaint with Poland's supervisory authority, the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (uodo.gov.pl). To exercise these rights, email kontakt@adrianantosiak.pl.
For any questions related to personal data, email kontakt@adrianantosiak.pl.
